name: teal_tunnel
description: a tunnel of bevelled arches: navy cells between bright teal arms, ring after ring shrinking towards a vanishing point left of centre, each ring the next octave of a self-similar point, fine cyan filaments sparkling along the arms
reuses: the style compositor, its palette, light and sheet layers, and the normal, screen and add blends
field de (the exterior distance estimate) as the palette's position: navy far from the set, teal at it, so the cells are dark and the arms bright
field de again as a halo sheet: a smooth teal band round every arm, the same width relative to the ring at every depth
field smooth as the light's height: one bevelled tube per ring, the arches
the tone pass, at the reference's median and p10
adds: projection log_polar: a per-sample pre-map c = center + (width/2)·exp(u + i·v), the frame's log-radius and angle as the strip (u, v), so every octave round a self-similar point is one ring of the picture; turns, power, twist, angle and ring, with the distance estimate and the light's normal carried through its Jacobian

member period on light and sheet: a band every period of the channel's raw value, counted in the projection's rings, instead of across the frame's stretch, so the bands stay the same at every depth of a view without end
location member projection: a record's own twist and ring, laid over the style's projection by `style render`
